shots.name: The Total Trap
shots.visual: Student staring at two brochures labelled Degree A and Degree B, both showing '100 Total Hours'.
shots.dialogue: Thinking B.Com and BBA are the same because they look equal? Think again.
shots.cameraPerformance: Close up on the student's confused face.

shots.name: The Assumption
shots.visual: Student holds up two cards, one for each degree, both with '100 Hours' written in bold.
shots.dialogue: Most students assume equal totals mean the exact same academic experience.
shots.cameraPerformance: Medium shot, student pointing at both cards.

shots.name: The Reveal
shots.visual: Student flips the cards over to reveal the breakdown.
shots.dialogue: But look at what is hiding underneath the total.
shots.cameraPerformance: Quick zoom onto the cards as they are flipped.

shots.name: The Breakdown
shots.visual: Graphic overlay appears showing: Example: Total: 100 hours (Degree A: 80 Theory/20 Project; Degree B: 40 Theory/60 Project).
shots.dialogue: Example: Total: 100 hours. Degree A is 80 theory, 20 project. Degree B is 40 theory, 60 project. Same total, different focus.

shots.cameraPerformance: Student pointing at the graphic as it appears.

shots.name: The Shift
shots.visual: Student puts the cards down and looks directly into the camera.
shots.dialogue: So, what is the specific breakdown of project vs. theory hours?
shots.onscreenText: What is the specific breakdown of project vs. theory hours?

shots.name: Actionable Habit
shots.visual: Student pulls out a notebook and starts sketching a comparison table.
shots.dialogue: Always ask for the breakdown before you decide.
shots.cameraPerformance: Over-the-shoulder shot showing the student drawing a grid.
